pr_title: statistics: async merge global stats to reduce memory usage
pr_body:
<!--

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #47219

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

In the old merge global stats, it is necessary to load all statistical information into memory and then perform a merge, which can easily lead to OOM.

Now, we start merging while loading, avoiding loading unnecessary data to prevent OOM, and at the same time improving efficiency.

issue_context.title: Better Performance of MergePartitionStats2GlobalStats
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently, the performance of the MergePartitionStats2GlobalStats function may not meet the requirements under certain complex scenarios or large data volumes, which may affect overall system performance and efficiency.

review_comments: Can we add more comments on it especially a diagram to show how multiple goroutines(workers) work together here? Just like what we've done for HashAgg: Done
Will it cost much effort to keep the old implementation, and separate the new implementation under a variable or fix control? Let's use the implementation for new cluster first.
